helpPlay: p <i>                    play a card from your hand
helpToep: t                        toep (raise the stake by one)
helpStay: s                        stay in after a toep
rankLine: ranking: 10 > 9 > 8 > 7 > A > K > Q > J (the ten is highest, the jack lowest)
promptPlay: p <i> to play (you must follow suit if you can) / t to toep
promptRespond: s to stay in, f to fold
hintReasonStay: you still hold something strong -- staying in is fine
hintReasonFold: nothing strong left; folding costs less than losing
hintReasonPlay: this is the cheapest card that still takes the trick
helpRedeal: d                        throw in a poverty hand (only A/K/Q/J) for a redeal
promptRedeal: your hand is nothing but A/K/Q/J -- d asks for a redeal
